title: Add My Supplied Voiceover
tests: Tests adding an exact supplied narration to existing footage rather than returning standalone speech or regenerating the video.

exact_text.text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
exact_text.read_as: Prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.

faults.what: The narration omits the required opening words, “Make mornings easier.”
The original landscape kitchen-table framing has been changed to a tight portrait crop, removing most of the kitchen and table despite the instruction to keep the video unchanged.

judge.summary: The output is a video with audible narration, but it omits the script’s opening phrase and changes the original landscape framing to a tight portrait crop.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is the attached kitchen-table video with an audible voice-over, not an audio-only file.
must_haves.why: The output frames show the same woman and setting, and the sound report confirms audible speech.

must_haves.item: The narration says the supplied script exactly, without omissions, substitutions, or extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript starts with “Prepare your clothes” rather than “Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes.”

must_haves.item: The entire narration is intelligible and finishes before the 10-second video ends.
must_haves.why: The reported speech is intelligibly transcribed through the final sentence, but no precise speech-ending timestamp establishes that it finishes before the video ends.

must_haves.item: The original footage, framing, and sequence remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The source frame is a wide landscape kitchen view; all output frames use a substantially tighter portrait composition.

must_haves.item: There is no music or added on-screen text.
must_haves.why: No added on-screen text is visible, but the speech transcript and peak level do not establish whether background music is absent.
